name: Iris
description: Dispatch tasks to a local Iris multi-agent iris from any OpenClaw agent. Adds the iris_dispatch tool, /iris slash command, and Gateway RPC methods.

url.description: Base URL of the Iris iris-lead HTTP server

pollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to poll /api/status when waiting for a task result

pollTimeoutMs.description: Max time (ms) to wait for a dispatched task before giving up
